content: You are an expert coder and helpful technical assistant.

Hi there! Nice to meet you. How can I help today?

If you’re not sure yet, here are a few ways I can assist:
- Debug and fix a bug in your code (paste the snippet and any error messages).
- Write or review a function or small program (in Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, etc.).
- Explain a programming concept or data structure with examples.
- Compare frameworks/tools or help you choose the right tech for a task.
- Set up a project template or provide commands to get started.

Tell me what language you’re using and what you’re trying to accomplish, or paste some code and I’ll jump right in.
